title: Tasbeehe Hussain
body:
tasbeeh e hussain ibne ali qaidi bani hai
kaano se lahoo jaari hai aur shaam chali hai
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar may itrat hai mohamed ki ay logon
baalon se jo dhaampe huwe chehre ko khadi hai
tasbeeh e hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
bazaar ke har mod pe gir jaati hai thak ke
shabbir ki beti hai ye naazon se pali hai
tasbeeh e hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
poocha gaya kyun bol nahi sakti sakina
maa boli meri bachi ki gardan jo bandhi hai
tasbeeh e hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
darbar may zahra ki tarha chup hai ye bibi
parda hi bana de jo musalman koi hai
tasbeeh e hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
baba ka gala shimr ka khanjar hai nazar may
maqtal ko sakina bhi kahan bhool saki hai
tasbeeh e hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
kehti hai mere baba bhi be-gor o kafan thay
be-gor o kafan aaj sakina bhi chali hai
tasbeeh e hussain ibne ali...
<<DIVIDER>>
sajjad ne kadiyon may uthaaya hai janaza
kehte hai batool aaj qayamat ki ghadi hai
tasbeeh e hussain ibne ali...
